name: Facets link field
description: Provides Facets processors specific to the core Link field.
project_description: Facets link field provides Facets processors built for Drupal's core Link field. Its single build-stage processor, TranslateEntityInLinkProcessor (plugin id facets_link_field_processors, label "Transform entity link to label"), applies to facets whose source is a link field configured to allow internal/generic URLs. For each facet result whose raw value is an internal entity link (a routed entity.<type>.canonical URI), it loads the referenced entity, switches to the current-language translation when available, and replaces the displayed value with that entity's label. An optional "Remove non entities" checkbox drops results whose link value does not resolve to a content entity. The module ships only this processor plugin: no routes, permissions, forms, services, config objects or config schema of its own.
